senses.gloss:
(I)--a manifestation of Hari during the epoch of Manu चाक्षुष. In this period the क्षीरोद was churned and nectar was secured.
1: भा. II. 2. 5; VIII. 5. 9-१०.
Praised by ब्रह्मा.
2: Ib. VIII. 5. २५-50.
Advised gods to befriend Asuras and then get अमृत by churning the ocean, with their co-operation, to be able ultimately to prevail against them;
3: Ib. VIII. 6. १८-25.
began to take part in अमृतमथन when the efforts of others produced no results.
4: Ib. VIII. 7. १६; X. 2. २०; X. ५१. ४८.
(III)--the name of Hari born in स्वारोचिष epoch from तुषिता. Br. III. 3. ११४.
(II)--the mother of devas known as Ajitas. वा. ६७. ३३. [page१-033+ ३०]
(I)--a group of gods with आयुष्मन्त formed १४ गणस् whose residence was Maharloka. From there they go to Janaloka. Br. III. 4. २७; IV. 1. १२२.

(II)--a देवगण;
1: वा. १०. २१.
they are Asama, उग्रदृष्टि, Sunaya, शुचिश्रवस्, Kevala, विश्वरूप, सुदक्ष, Madhupa, Turiya, Indrayuk.
2: Br. II. 9. ४६; १३. ९०.
Remembered by ब्रह्मा.
3: वा. ३१. 4.
(III)--sons of Ajita and Ruci in the स्वायम्- bhuva Manvantara. वा. ६७. ३३.
--a sage who sold his second son शुनःशेफ to Rohita to be sacrificed in his place. भा. IX. 7. २०-21; IX. १६. ३०.
--शुनःशेप, the son of Ajigarta--(see अजि- गर्त, s.v.). भा. IX. १६. ३०; IX. 7. २०-21.
